QF.id: AIFM CIII Legal Documents and Negotiations_21

question.text: Which of the following statements about SEBI's relationship with the PPM of a Cat III AIF is CORRECT?

answer.text: SEBI approves the PPM as true and accurate before any AIF launches a scheme.
SEBI provides only observations on the PPM; it does not approve the document, and responsibility for accuracy rests with the Manager.
SEBI's observations are confidential and never shared with the merchant banker.
SEBI guarantees the performance claims in the PPM's Track Record section.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 236, SEBI may communicate comments to the merchant banker, provides only observations on the PPM, and does not approve the document. The Manager is responsible for ensuring that the PPM contains true and accurate information. The Trap: Option A confuses SEBI registration of the AIF with approval of the PPM contents. Option C wrongly makes the observations secret; they are communicated to the merchant banker. Option D fabricates a SEBI performance guarantee. Note: Anchor the answer on the SEBI observation-and-no-approval disclaimer and the Manager's responsibility for accuracy.
